summary: Similarweb Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release of its Q1 2026 financial results. The release reports revenue of $73.9M (up 10% YoY), GAAP net loss of $(6.4)M, and non-GAAP operating profit of $2.4M. It highlights top-end guidance performance, multi-year subscriptions reaching 64% of ARR, and positive normalized free cash flow for the tenth consecutive quarter. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation. There are no M&A, activist, restructuring, or capital return events. The filing is an ordinary disclosure of periodic financial results, with no special-situation implications.
